errors.text_span: 图表的中轴线表示“出现次数”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the horizontal axis as the "central axis" (中轴线), which is non-standard terminology. More importantly, it incorrectly states that this axis, labeled "出现次数" (Number of occurrences), represents the "框架数量" (number of frameworks), effectively swapping the meanings of the x and y axes.
The horizontal axis is not on a linear scale. The tick marks are powers of 2 (2^0, 2^1, 2^2, etc.), indicating a logarithmic scale.
The range of the horizontal axis tick labels extends to 2^10, not just 2^9.

errors.text_span: 图表上的另一条轴线表示框架编号
errors.evidence: This appears to refer to the vertical axis, but its label is "频数(框架数)" (Frequency (Number of frameworks)), not "框架编号" (framework number). The description has fundamentally misinterpreted what the axes represent.

errors.text_span: 每个柱子代表一个框架编号，柱子的高度表示相应的框架出现次数
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the visual elements to the axes. Each bar represents a bin for the "出现次数" (Number of occurrences) on the x-axis, and its height represents the "频数(框架数)" (Frequency (Number of frameworks)) on the y-axis. The description has this reversed.
The height of the leftmost bar (at x=2^0) is approximately 49, not 60. The value 60 is the maximum value on the y-axis scale.
The bar at 2^9 is not the rightmost bar. There are visible bars at 2^10 and even one after that.
The height of the bar at x=2^9 is approximately 5, not 10.

errors.text_span: 该折线从左到右地从右侧下降
errors.evidence: The phrasing "descends from the right side from left to right" is awkward and confusing. A clearer description would be "descends from left to right".

errors.text_span: 表明重复出现的框架数量的存在
errors.evidence: This is an interpretation of the data's meaning, which violates the prompt's instruction to "Avoid interpreting results, drawing conclusions, or speculating about the meaning of the data."
